definitions.gloss: founder (of a religious sect, school of thought or art)
definitions.explanation: The person who founded a religious sect or a school or style of an art, martial art or craft. Used of figures such as the founders of Buddhist sects, schools of tea ceremony or karate styles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{流派|りゅうは}→流派：13365_ryuuha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開祖|かいそ}。
⟦{空海|くうかい}→空海：31131_kuukai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{真言宗|しんごんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開祖|かいそ}だ。
examples.english: Kūkai is the founder of the Shingon sect.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道場|どうじょう}→道場：14326_doujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{開祖|かいそ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{伝|つた}えられる→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飾|かざ}られている→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: This training hall displays a piece of calligraphy said to have been written by the school's founder.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜{宗|しゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開祖|かいそ}: the founder of the ~ sect
- ⟦{流派|りゅうは}→流派：13365_ryuuha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開祖|かいそ}: the founder of a school (of an art or martial art)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{教祖|きょうそ}→教祖：32806_kyouso⟧: the founder of a religion, often a new one; can sound critical
- ⟦{創始者|そうししゃ}→創始者：27181_soushisha⟧: founder, originator of anything, including companies and theories
- {祖|そ}: forefather, originator; literary
